entries.title: Study in GCC | ILMERA Study Abroad
entries.description: ILMERA supports students applying to universities in all six GCC countries: UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Kuwait, Oman and Bahrain. Official-source information on this page currently covers the UAE, Qatar, Saudi Arabia, Oman and Bahrain; Oman and Bahrain coverage is limited to student registration. Kuwait information is not yet available here from a verified official source, so students should confirm Kuwait requirements directly with the relevant institution and authority.

entries.title: Study in Germany | ILMERA Study Abroad
entries.description: At German public institutions, bachelor programmes and most master programmes normally have no tuition. Baden-Wuerttemberg charges non-EU tuition; Bavarian institutions may also charge. All students pay a separate semester contribution, and living costs still apply. Check the selected programme before budgeting.

entries.title: Study in Italy | ILMERA Study Abroad
entries.description: Indian students who want to study in Italy first apply for admission to the Italian institution, then complete pre-enrolment on the Universitaly portal, then apply for a study visa by appointment at a VFS centre. Each institution sets its own admission requirements, deadlines and tuition fees.

entries.title: Study in Latvia | ILMERA Study Abroad
entries.description: Indian students admitted to an accredited Latvian institution apply for a long stay visa at the Embassy of Latvia in India. The visa is valid for 90 days. After entering Latvia, students apply for a residence permit at the Office of Citizenship and Migration Affairs.

entries.title: Study in Lithuania | ILMERA Study Abroad
entries.description: Tuition fees vary by university and programme, and the European Commission study portal puts the average at from 1,300 euros a year for bachelor programmes, from 2,300 for master programmes and from 8,400 for doctoral programmes. More than 500 programmes are taught in English. Check each university for exact fees.

entries.title: Study in Slovakia | ILMERA Study Abroad
entries.description: Full-time study in Slovak at public institutions can involve no tuition, while programmes taught in English or other foreign languages carry fees. Check the individual programme requirements and budget for living expenses separately. Admission decisions and deadlines are set by each institution.

entries.title: Study in UK | ILMERA Study Abroad
entries.description: Most UK Student visa applicants need funding for the course fees shown on their CAS and living costs. Current monthly amounts are 1,171 pounds outside London or 1,529 pounds in London, for up to nine months. Some financial-evidence exemptions apply; check the rules for your circumstances.
